data.credibility: Management demonstrates mixed delivery. They consistently meet headline financial guidance like revenue growth and capex targets, but frequently drop or quietly stop reporting on specific brand and expansion targets made in prior quarters.

lines.line: Promised 30 plus hotel openings; status is currently slipping with no mentions in subsequent quarters.
Management expects ongoing healthy growth in management fees with strong EBITDA flow-through; currently on track.
Targeted 30% new business growth in H2; exchange data shows 16.3% for FY26, resulting in a miss.
Taj Ganges 100-key expansion opened at the end of December or Q4 as expected; kept.
Taj Lucknow 95-key expansion targeted for 2027 was dropped from tracking.
Guided double-digit revenue growth; delivered 16.3% in FY26 according to exchange data; kept.
Expected FY26 capex between Rs. 1000 and 1200 crores; delivered Rs. 1000 crores; kept.
Scaled Tree of Life target to 100 hotels; subsequently dropped.
Guided 60 plus openings in FY27; dropped in later quarters.
Ginger and new verticals expected to deliver 25% plus revenue growth; delivered 25.0% in FY26; kept.
Atmantan projected at INR 100 crores revenue in FY27; dropped.
Brij acquisition expected to contribute INR 100 crores in FY27; dropped.
Recent acquisitions expected to add INR 250 to 300 crores in FY27; dropped.
Guided double-digit revenue growth in FY27; exchange data shows 18.2% so far; on track.
Expected annual capex of INR 1,000 to 1,200 crores; dropped from reporting.
Ginger brand expected to reach 250 hotels by end of FY27; on track.
Approaching 650 hotels milestone; currently slipping with no mention in Q2 FY27.
Ginger brand targeted to reach 150 operational hotels by March 31, FY27; pending.
Hotel segment revenue expected to grow 17% to 19% in FY27; 18.2% achieved so far; on track.

bull: Revenue compounded at 43.8% annually over five years, reaching a TTM revenue of ₹10,431 cr with net profit at ₹2,370 cr.
EBITDA margin recovered significantly from -23.0% in FY21 to 33.0% in FY26, alongside strong operating cash flow at 139% of profit.
Balance sheet is lightly geared with borrowings falling to ₹3,471 cr against a net worth of ₹13,640 cr, bringing debt-to-equity to 0.25.
bear: Growth is slowing down noticeably, dropping to 18.6% annually over three years compared to 43.8% over five years.
Management frequently drops specific forward-looking operational targets, such as the Atmantan and Brij acquisition contributions and hotel count goals.
Valuation appears elevated with a P/E ratio of 64.6, matching expectations for high continuity in top-line growth.
